description: This file defines API endpoints for authentication-related operations in a FastAPI application, including user registration, login, and retrieval of current user info.

classes.name: APIRouter
classes.description: FastAPI router instance used to define API routes related to authentication.

classes.name: UserOut
classes.description: Schema for the output representation of user data.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Schema for the JWT token response upon login.

classes.name: LoginRequest
classes.description: Schema for the login request payload.

classes.name: RegisterRequest
classes.description: Schema for the registration request payload.

methods.name: UserOut register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new user, assigns roles, and returns user info.

methods.name: TokenResponse login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Authenticates user credentials and returns a JWT token.

methods.name: UserOut me(user: User = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Returns the details of the currently authenticated user.

ctags.name: login
ctags.pattern: /^def login(payload: LoginRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> TokenResponse:$/

ctags.name: register
ctags.pattern: /^def register(payload: RegisterRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> UserOut:$/
